cases.purpose: swapoff -a over controlled /proc/swaps tables (header only, empty, wrong header, octal escapes, duplicate rows, malformed rows) under a non-forwarding seccomp notifier: status, diagnostics and the ordered decoded requests.
cases.oracle: util-linux 2.41 swapoff run by the helper on each table under the same notifier; EINVAL for every swapoff request.
cases.comparison: For each table the candidate status, stdout, diagnostics (minus the shell-location prefix) and ordered request paths must equal util-linux's; the expected stdout records the request count and status util-linux 2.41.5 gave for each table.
cases.stdout:
header-only: same as util-linux, 0 requests, status 0
missing-header: same as util-linux, 0 requests, status 0
invalid-header: same as util-linux, 1 requests, status 32
escapes: same as util-linux, 5 requests, status 32
duplicates: same as util-linux, 3 requests, status 32
malformed: same as util-linux, 3 requests, status 32
decoded-duplicate: same as util-linux, 3 requests, status 32
